notes.title: Ponglow autumn update
notes.content: Todays update brings new physics, new rules, themes and more.

notes.title: Ponglow Super Theme update
notes.content: Todays update brings the super hero theme, minor changes and fixes to gameplay and finally new sound tracks to replace old ones

notes.title: New Themes Update
notes.content:
To days update brings 2 new themes, The Egyptian theme and trippy theme. Also all original modes have had art updates and more. Some bugs with the ball are fixed. If you come across any bugs please let us know in the forums.

Thanks

notes.title: Ponglow Update 6/14/2019
notes.content:
Updated

- Updated the chance of different themes loading. You will now get other themes loading almost all the time rather then the 666 in 1 chance.
- Added more special blocks for those who get past level 10
- Added 3 new tunes made by Kash production
- Move the end game dev block to level 30+


Things to come 

-Graphic Updates
-2 player
-Level editor


Cheers!
